metadata.question: Did the sea surface temperatures in March 2022 at a location 100 km offshore east of Cairns, Australia, show temperature changes greater than 1°C compared to the overall average water temperatures from 2003 to 2014?

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
cairns_point = ee.Geometry.Point([147.0, -16.9])  # 100 km offshore east of Cairns
march_2022 = ('2022-03-01', '2022-03-31')
baseline_period = ('2003-01-01', '2014-12-31')

# 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Aqua SST
sst_col = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI')

# Get March 2022 SST
march_2022_sst = sst_col.filterBounds(cairns_point)\
                        .filterDate(march_2022[0], march_2022[1])\
                        .select('sst')

# Get baseline SST (2003-2014)
baseline_sst = sst_col.filterBounds(cairns_point)\
                      .filterDate(baseline_period[0], baseline_period[1])\
                      .select('sst')

# Check collection sizes
march_count = march_2022_sst.size().getInfo()
baseline_count = baseline_sst.size().getInfo()

print(f"March 2022 Images: {march_count}")
print(f"Baseline Images: {baseline_count}")

if march_count == 0 or baseline_count == 0:
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # Process March 2022 data (mean composite)
    march_mean = march_2022_sst.mean()
    
    # Process baseline data (mean composite)
    baseline_mean = baseline_sst.mean()
    
    # Calculate pixel counts to check for valid data
    march_count_pixels = march_mean.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=cairns_point,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('sst').getInfo()
    
    baseline_count_pixels = baseline_mean.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=cairns_point,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('sst').getInfo()
    
    print(f"March 2022 Valid Pixels: {march_count_pixels}")
    print(f"Baseline Valid Pixels: {baseline_count_pixels}")
    
    if march_count_pixels == 0 or baseline_count_pixels == 0:
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    else:
        # Calculate SST values (convert from Kelvin to Celsius)
        march_sst = march_mean.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=cairns_point,
            scale=1000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('sst').getInfo()
        
        baseline_sst_val = baseline_mean.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=cairns_point,
            scale=1000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('sst').getInfo()
        
        # Convert from Kelvin to Celsius
        if march_sst is not None and baseline_sst_val is not None:
            march_sst_c = march_sst - 273.15
            baseline_sst_c = baseline_sst_val - 273.15
            difference = march_sst_c - baseline_sst_c
            
            print(f"March 2022 SST: {march_sst_c:.2f}°C")
            print(f"Baseline SST: {baseline_sst_c:.2f}°C")
            print(f"Difference: {difference:.2f}°C")
            
            # Validate temperature range (reasonable SST values)
            if (march_sst_c < -2 or march_sst_c > 40 or 
                baseline_sst_c < -2 or baseline_sst_c > 40):
                print("<answer>C3</answer>")
            elif difference > 1.0:
                print("<answer>A</answer>")
            else:
                print("<answer>B</answer>")
        else:
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
